donationCheckout.title: Pay {amount}
donationCheckout.lead: Pay by card, UPI or net banking. Your receipt link comes by email as soon as the payment goes through.

errors.not_found: We couldn't find this donation. Please start again from the donate page.
errors.gateway_unavailable: The payment service isn't answering. Nothing was charged. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.superseded: This payment changed in another window. Reload the page to see it.
errors.failed: Something went wrong and nothing was charged. Please try again.

captured.title: Thank you for giving {amount}
captured.body: Your receipt number is {number}. We have emailed you a link to your receipt. It works for 7 days, so save or print the receipt before then.
captured.lost: Didn't get the email, or the link has expired? Ask for a new link

pending.title: We are waiting for your bank
pending.body: We haven't heard back about your payment of {amount} yet. This page updates when you reload it, and we email your receipt as soon as the payment goes through.

failed.title: Your payment didn't go through
failed.body: Nothing was taken. You can try again with another card or UPI app.

expired.title: This donation has expired
expired.body: The payment wasn't finished in time, so nothing was taken. If money did leave your account, it comes back to you or we contact you.

foreign.title: We have returned your payment
foreign.body: Your payment of {amount} came from a card or account outside India. The law lets us accept donations only from Indian sources for now, so we are returning all of it. A card refund usually arrives within 5 to 7 working days.

refunded.title: This donation was refunded
refunded.body: We returned your gift of {amount}, and its receipt is cancelled.
